scenario_description:
Objective: Add a brief no-cost hand-comfort tool trial to an already planned clay-supply stop.
Emerging Need: A generic store notice becomes actionable only after an open studio gap and a specific same-day counter card are visible.
Decision Context: Saved occupational-therapy guidance distinguishes this table from ordinary browsing and identifies what to bring; calendar, message, and store updates define fit and cutoff.
Consequence: Timely organization could yield practical wheel-tool ideas without changing the pickup plan; ignoring it leaves the ordinary errand unchanged, and after the counter releases cards the extra benefit is unavailable.

parameter.title: Clay reclaim pickup at Santa Fe Clay Supply
parameter.description: Pick up reserved reclaim clay and receipt from the front counter.

parameter.subject: Educator Friday: hand-comfort table may run today
parameter.body: Our visiting tool rep may run a free hand-comfort comparison table for educators this afternoon if the demo kit arrives. Walk-in timing and any counter cards will be posted after noon; no advance sign-ups are being taken.

parameter.content: I can take the 12:30 reclaim-sorting shift today, so after your supply pickup you don't need to come straight back unless you want extra studio time.

parameter.subject: Hand-comfort table: two Friday counter cards
parameter.body: The demo kit is here. Two free 10-minute educator counter cards remain for today, 2:50 p.m. and 3:05 p.m. Ask at the front counter by 2:25 p.m. to take one; no purchase is required, and bringing the tool you normally use gives the rep better comparisons.

parameter.subject: Friday hand-comfort cards are closed
parameter.body: All remaining hand-comfort table counter cards were released at 2:25 p.m. and are now taken. The supply pickup counter remains open as usual until 5:00 p.m.
